# PortrAI

> AI photo booth for events. Headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia. Award-winning (Booth Mastermind Awards Las Vegas 2024 — Best AI Photo Solution + Best Newcomer). Operates in EE, FI, DE, LV, PL, BE, US.

## Services
- AI photo booth for weddings, corporate events, and trade shows
- Custom-themed AI portrait generation (acrylic, watercolour, pencil, cartoon, street-art styles)
- Branded experience design for trade shows ("messilahendused")
- Custom premium event solutions ("erilahendused")
- International consulting for photo booth operators

## Key facts
- Founded in Estonia
- First Baltic company to win Booth Mastermind Awards in Las Vegas (2024, two categories)
- Notable projects: Laulupidu (Postimees), Von Fock brand activation, MELT Innovation Forum
- Proprietary software (not generic face-swap)
- Instant on-site printing + QR code delivery
